text:
sara_harrison: Quick company-wide heads-up: we're changing the open-ended Starter free-credit slab to a fixed onboarding bundle. Cutover date = 2026-06-01 (90-day notice). Details below. :mega:

matt_lee: TL;DR: new signups get a 7-day trial + one-time $50 onboarding credit. Existing customers' current credits will be honored or prorated onto a single invoice credit. Dedicated/enterprise customers unaffected.

anna_finance: Finance details: we'll run a proration job and issue invoice credits for leftover legacy slabs. No retroactive charges. Cutover actions: CSV of affected accounts by 2026-05-10; dry run export on 2026-05-17.

ops-bot: [Auto] Internal guide created: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/onboarding-change (ops-only)

jessica_support: Support playbook in progress with short reply templates and escalation flow. Key line: "Your existing credits will be honored; new signups receive a time-limited onboarding bundle." I'll post the playbook to #help by EOD.

sara_harrison: Comms plan: banner + email on 2026-05-15; blog explainer on 2026-05-20. Sales outreach to top-100 heavy free-slab users is required. @matt_lee to own the list export.

matt_lee: On it. I'll export and share with AE leads tomorrow.

sara_harrison: Action items recap: @matt_lee export list (TOM); @anna_finance CSV & proration (5/10); @jessica_support publish playbook (EOD); marketing/comms to prepare banner + email (2w). Ping me for legal review. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
